cleanup.implementation: Mechanical System.Drawing processing on Windows; source shapes preserved.
cleanup.sourcePixelAcceptance: alpha >= 192, minimum RGB channel >= 100, maximum minus minimum RGB channel < 80. This rejects soft halos and coloured generation fringe.
cleanup.crop: Bounding box of accepted pixels, recorded per source as x,y,width,height.
cleanup.sampling: Preserve crop aspect ratio; content width 40,32,58,88,76 respectively, height rounded to nearest integer. Each output cell uses rounded source block boundaries. Opaque iff at least half the block's source pixels are accepted; use independent RGB medians (upper median for even sample counts).
cleanup.paletteMapping: Nearest RGB Euclidean distance to [#A8B9BD,#BECAC6,#D9D4BE], no dithering.
cleanup.denoise: One pass on a snapshot of the quantized image: an opaque pixel with all eight neighbours opaque and at most one neighbour of its colour takes the most frequent neighbour palette colour (ties prefer lower palette index). Silhouette alpha unchanged.
cleanup.output: Two clear pixels of padding on every side. Transparent RGB zero; RGBA PNG with only 0/255 alpha.
cleanup.previews: Mechanical nearest-neighbour compositing at 3x for contact sheet and 1x onto existing environment-preview.png for the six-stage review; palette swaps exactly as manifest.
